versions.changelog:
Initial release: Automatically converts traditional "Job Description Manuals" into structured system prompts for digital employees (AI Agents) using Chudaxia's seven-layer template.

- Deeply analyzes and parses job descriptions from the knowledge base, outputting a complete seven-layer Markdown prompt card.
- Rigidly enforces Markdown structure and output standards for direct deployment.
- Ensures all prompts are company-agnostic, actionable, and internally consistent across all layers.
- Implements mandatory post-generation self-check with correction before final delivery.
- Supports batch processing for multiple positions with per-position output and summary table.
